title: Egyptian-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection, inspired by the flavors of Egypt.

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cardamom

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Egyptian spices, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they're evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, with your favorite sides.
